_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
"The container" is the messages container (".messages-container"), "the button" the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button"), and "the gap" the container's scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop. To "send" a message, fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with it and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]). Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable. Perform the steps in order. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first message is "echo message 0". To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input to be visible (allow 30s). To "add message N", send "echo message N" and wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing the text "echo message N" is visible (allow 30s). A touch whose element is removed while the finger is down still ends, so following continues. The page provides window.__addCollapsible(): it inserts a 400px block, with a "Collapse" button ([data-testid="collapse-test"]) at its bottom, before the container's bottom sentinel, waits for following to reach it, and resolves to the gap.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Enough content that the list actually scrolls: add message 1 and wait until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s); then add message 2 and wait until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s); then add message 3 and wait until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s).
3. Wait until Math.abs(gap) <= 1 is true (an eval expecting true: the gap can be fractional). The button must not be visible (allow 5s).
4. Eval Math.abs(await window.__addCollapsible()) <= 1 expecting true.
5. A touch start step on [data-testid="collapse-test"] (native touch).
6. Eval document.querySelector('[data-testid="collapse-test"]').remove() without expect (only the button: the block keeps its height).
7. A touch end step.
8. Send "echo after removed touch" and wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing "echo after removed touch" is visible (allow 30s).
9. Still following: wait until Math.abs(gap) <= 1 is true (allow 10s), and the button must not be visible (allow 5s).

steps.expression: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); return Math.abs(c.scrollHeight - c.clientHeight - c.scrollTop) <= 1; })()
